items.source: Return true to mark a property as read only.
items.translation: 将属性标记为只读时返回 true。

items.source: Return true to mark a property as transient.
items.translation: 将属性标记为瞬态时返回 true。

items.source: Treats the property to which the instance is applied as read only.
items.translation: 将应用该实例的属性视为只读。

items.source: Treats the property to which the instance is applied as transient.
items.translation: 将实例所应用的属性视为临时对象。

items.source:
null to leave the defaults, true or false
otherwise
items.translation: 留空以使用默认值，true 或 false；否则。

items.source: The characteristics of a Neo4jPersistentProperty can diverge from what is by default derived from the annotated classes. Diverging characteristics are requested by the Neo4jMappingContext prior to creating a persistent property. Additional providers of characteristics may be registered with the mapping context.
items.translation: Neo4jPersistentProperty 的特性可能与从注解类中默认推导出的特性存在差异。在创建持久化属性之前，Neo4jMappingContext 会请求这些不同的特性。此外，还可以向映射上下文注册额外的特性提供者。

items.source: characteristics to treat a property as transient
items.translation: 将财产视为临时性的特征

items.source: characteristics to treat a property as read only
items.translation: 将属性视为只读的特性
